order_book: Financially, we have delivered our highest ever quarterly revenue, supported by improved execution of the rising order backlog and the contribution from our recently acquired Brazilian entity, 2S.

The quarter also saw our order bookings of US$339 million, taking our order backlog to a record ever of approximately US$950 million, up 83% year-on-year and providing strong visibility for future growth.
